triennialProviderSource.description: Provider identifies CJLS/Eisenberg system with Cohen2020 and Heller2012 amendments. No provider code imported; independent comparison of all divisions to RA source tables remains pending.

editionPolicy: Torah and structured related-reading units must match UXLC boundaries and verse counts. Exact source strings, notes, array order and numbered keys are retained. Partial/ambiguous verses and unsupported structures stay reference-only. Consecutive Megillah source units can form one tutor section, with the complete source snapshot/selection retained. Liturgical variants do not select a melody or pronunciation.
networkPolicy: Only an explicit month load/refresh contacts Hebcal programmatically; no geolocation, time-of-day or candle-lighting data. Chosen month/Israel-Diaspora flag sent. Up to12 loaded month responses cached; eight source examples bundled. Source links are opened only on user action.

regressionFixtures.reason: 17 records include ErevPurim Megillah-only reference; it must not reject the month or fabricate Torah divisions. Promoted to a bundled example in candidate0.16.

sourceClaimLimit: Fresh responses are checksum-pinned after validation. Assignment import validates source-snapshot structure, counts and selected boundaries locally; retained response hash is attribution metadata, not independent revalidation of the full provider response or congregational/musical approval.

torahNumbering.policy: Exodus20/Deuteronomy5 source coordinates are explicitly mapped to unchanged UXLC records, after all53 source preferred-letter sequences matched59 target records. Original source references/counts and mapped target counts survive v3assignments. Other ranges keep numeric references with strict source-count checks. Upper/lower chant and source mark ordering are not changed.
